what_this_is: The planted-defect log for tests/test_memo.py, regenerated by experiments/exact_memo/run_plants.py. Each entry was applied to a pristine copy of the file named, CONFIRMED to parse and to be REACHED (reached_by is the probe's own output), then the suite was run and its failures recorded, then the file was restored and compared byte-for-byte. The suite is asserted green before the first plant and after the last.
